capabilities.name: delivery-sandbox
capabilities.purpose: Provide an isolated disposable local or self-hosted environment for exact-candidate validation with required services without touching production or requiring hosted CI.

triggers.description: The responsibility needs an isolated runnable environment rather than static/repository-only checks.
Validation needs a database, auth, storage, queues, workers, cache, or other stateful/dependent services.
A disposable database or local Supabase-like stack is useful to validate schema, migrations, seed data, or integration behavior.
Local replay/preflight of delivery automation would provide useful evidence before or instead of spending a hosted CI run.
The responsibility needs an isolated preview/staging-style environment before production.
An exact release/deployment candidate must be started, exercised, smoke-tested, or verified with dependent services.

capabilities.negative_rule: Do not recommend when repository-owned checks already provide sufficient evidence without an isolated runtime or dependent services.

capabilities.name: windows-app-trust
capabilities.purpose: Audit, sign, validate, and safely configure Windows application trust for repository-built artifacts without weakening host security controls.

triggers.description: The responsibility produces or consumes a Windows EXE, DLL, MSI, MSIX, or PowerShell artifact whose trust/signature state matters.
A Windows artifact needs Authenticode signing as part of local use, release preparation, or distribution.
Release/security evidence must verify the signer, signature status, trusted chain, or publisher identity of a Windows artifact.
Smart App Control blocks a repository-built Windows artifact and the trust model must be diagnosed without disabling security controls.
A controlled developer/workstation environment needs explicit reversible local trust for a project signer.
An existing App Control for Business environment needs a narrowly scoped project signer policy or verification workflow.
A Windows release targets arbitrary external users and requires a deliberate publicly trusted signing path.

capabilities.negative_rule: Do not recommend merely because the host or project supports Windows. Require a concrete artifact-signing, signature-verification, trust-block, local-publisher-trust, App Control, or public Windows distribution need.

capabilities.name: comfyui-local
capabilities.purpose: Create, edit, and validate requested creative assets through an existing local ComfyUI runtime, and deliver editable workflows and generated files independently of ASPS.

triggers.description: The responsibility explicitly needs a generated image, video, or other creative asset supported by the local runtime.
The task explicitly needs an existing creative asset edited or transformed through a local ComfyUI workflow.
The task requests an editable ComfyUI workflow with its inputs and results so the user can inspect or continue it in Desktop.
A real media fixture generated through the target workflow is needed for a specific acceptance check; existing healthy fixtures or synthetic data do not cover that check.

capabilities.negative_rule: Do not recommend merely because ComfyUI, a GPU, Windows, local models, or the plugin are present or installed. Require a concrete requested asset, asset edit, editable workflow, or necessary media-fixture need. Do not recommend when an existing asset or repository-native diagram already satisfies the task.
